description: This file implements a client library for interacting with a Host Orchestrator service in a Cuttlefish environment. It defines interfaces, data structures, and methods for managing devices, connections, file uploads, and other operations on remote hosts via HTTP and WebRTC.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the error message for ApiCallError.

methods.name: ApplyToHTTPRequest
methods.description: Adds authentication headers to the request builder.

methods.name: ConnectWebRTC
methods.description: Establishes a WebRTC connection to a device in the host, setting up signaling and ICE servers.

methods.name: ConnectADBWebSocket
methods.description: Connects to the ADB WebSocket endpoint for a device.

methods.name: CreateCVD
methods.description: Creates a new CVD device instance with optional build artifacts.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a device with specified configuration.

methods.name: CreateSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of a device.

methods.name: CreateUploadDir
methods.description: Creates a directory for uploading user artifacts.

methods.name: UploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file using default upload options.

methods.name: UploadFileWithOptions
methods.description: Uploads a file using specified upload options.

methods.name: ExtractFile
methods.description: Extracts a compressed file in the user artifacts directory.

methods.name: CreateBugReport
methods.description: Generates a bug report for a CVD device.
